information:
There is an event wise participation limit for this competition.
The Participation limit for each event is as follows,
3x3x3 - 400 participants
2x2x2-300 participants only
Pyraminx-300 participants only
3x3x3 OH, Skewb, 4x4x4 - 150 participants only
Megaminx, 5x5x5 - 100 participants only
SQ1, Clock, 6x6x6, 7x7x7, 3BLD - 50 participants only
MBLD,4BLD,5BLD - 20 participants only
FMC - 40 participants only
Feet - 25 participants only

Registration for the event will only be accepted if a person has preregistered on the WCA page AND made the payment.
For more details on the registration process please check the [registration tab.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SCMU2017#1846-registration-payment)
For the competition Schedule please check the [schedule tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SCMU2017#1847-schedule)
To check the final list of registered participants and to know how many spots are left in each event [click here](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1J1rhRkqQeGdLmAuRNFetI6Vr3UWPDsLDV1ffU9b1nDY)
